- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/28 (Sun) 02:55
- [FACT] User has a new orchid plant received as a gift.
- [FACT] User has a thriving herb garden.
- [EVENT] User made a delicious pesto pasta dish on March 15th.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Congratulations on the new orchid plant and the herb garden.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for caring for an orchid include:
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] **Lighting:** Orchids prefer bright, indirect light; avoid direct sunlight.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] **Watering:** Water once a week in summer and every 10-14 days in winter; check soil moisture.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] **Humidity:** Orchids thrive in 40-70% humidity; use a tray with water and pebbles or a humidifier.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] **Temperature:** Daytime 65°F (18°C) to 75°F (24°C), nighttime 55°F (13°C) to 65°F (18°C).
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] **Fertilizing:** Use a balanced, water-soluble fertilizer (20-20-20) once a month, diluted to half strength.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] **Potting medium:** Use well-draining media like sphagnum moss; avoid regular potting soil.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] **Repotting:** Repot every 1-3 years; choose a slightly larger pot.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] **Pruning:** Cut back flower spikes after blooming to encourage new growth.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Additional tips include avoiding sudden temperature changes, not letting the plant sit in water, and monitoring for pests.
- [USER] User is interested in more information about fertilizing the orchid.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended balanced fertilizers include:
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Miracle-Gro Orchid Food (20-20-20)
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Schultz Orchid Food (20-20-20)
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Espoma Organic Orchid Tone Fertilizer (5-2-6)
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Fertilize once a month or every 4-6 weeks to avoid over-fertilization.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] If the orchid is in a pot with poor drainage, it should be repotted into a pot with better drainage.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Signs that the orchid needs repotting include soggy potting medium, roots outgrowing the pot, and signs of
